utilization_vs_cost_correlations.interpretation: Near-zero correlation: Billing is decoupled from load. Idle VMs cost the same as 100% utilized VMs.
High positive correlation: Costs scale directly with incoming transaction volume.
Perfect linear correlation (r=1.0): Cost is directly determined by data volume scanned per query.

carbon_analytics.disclaimer: All values are engineering estimates derived via SPECpower and GHG Protocol Scope 2 & 3 methodology, not official cloud-provider measurements.

methodology_assumptions.framework: Cloud Carbon Footprint (CCF) Open Standard & GHG Protocol Corporate Standard
methodology_assumptions.power_model: SPECpower server benchmark with dynamic CPU utilization scaling
methodology_assumptions.qualification: All carbon figures are scientific estimates and not official cloud-provider billed emissions.
